verdict.text: SerpApi uses API key authentication rather than an OAuth app registration process. Access is instant upon signing up and verifying your account, with no review required.
verdict.label: Inferred
verdict.note: SerpApi documentation only references authenticating via an account API key rather than registering an OAuth client app.

hands_on_time.label: Inferred
hands_on_time.note: Signing up, verifying email details, and retrieving the API key takes only a few minutes.

waiting_time.label: Inferred
waiting_time.note: API keys are generated immediately without an external review period.

prerequisites.text: A SerpApi account with a verified email address.
prerequisites.label: Sourced
prerequisites.quote: First, create an account and verify your email and other details. After that, get the API key from your account dashboard.

setup_steps.text: Navigate to https://serpapi.com/users/sign_up?plan=free and sign up for a free account.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: The sign-up page URL is provided in the official blog references and observed endpoints.

setup_steps.text: Verify your email address and any additional details requested during sign-up.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: First, create an account and verify your email and other details.

setup_steps.text: Navigate to the API key dashboard at https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key to view your private API key.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Parameter defines the SerpApi private key to use. You can find it under your account -> API key.

setup_steps.text: Copy your private API key and store it securely or paste it into your Composio toolkit configuration.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: The API key must be saved securely or configured in client settings for authentication.

scopes.text: SerpApi does not use OAuth scopes; authentication is managed entirely through a private account-level API key.
scopes.label: Inferred
scopes.note: All documented SerpApi endpoints authorize requests using an api_key parameter.

limits_before_approval.text: Free tier accounts are limited to 250 searches per month.
limits_before_approval.label: Sourced

approval_process.text: There is no formal app approval or review process; API access is activated upon email verification.
approval_process.label: Inferred
approval_process.note: Docs describe obtaining the API key directly from the dashboard after creating and verifying an account.

likely_blockers.text: Unverified email address preventing dashboard and API key access.
likely_blockers.label: Inferred
likely_blockers.note: Email verification is explicitly required during account onboarding.

likely_blockers.text: Exceeding the free tier allowance of 250 searches per month, requiring a paid subscription upgrade.
likely_blockers.label: Inferred
likely_blockers.note: Accounts requiring higher capacity must upgrade to a paid plan.

agent_can_do: Format API requests with the api_key parameter
Configure Composio integrations using the API key
you_must_do: Sign up on the SerpApi registration page
Copy the API key from your SerpApi dashboard and supply it to your application or agent

open_questions.text: Does SerpApi provide granular permission keys or restricted tokens for team members?
open_questions.label: Uncertain
open_questions.note: The provided docs mention team management features but do not describe scoped sub-keys.
